title: Basic Personal Questions
prompt: Answer the following personal questions with one sentence.
hint: Use simple sentences to answer questions about yourself.

ja.prompt: 以下の個人的な質問に一文で答えてください。
ja.hint: 自分についての質問には簡単な文で答えましょう。
ja.sample: 私の名前はエスターです。

local.prompt: Answer the following personal questions with one sentence.
local.hint: Use simple sentences to answer questions about yourself.

zh.prompt: 用一句話回答以下個人問題。
zh.hint: 用簡單句子回答關於你自己的問題。

en.prompt: Answer the following personal questions with one sentence.
en.hint: Use simple sentences to answer questions about yourself.

title: Daily Routine Questions
prompt: Answer questions about your daily routine in one sentence.
hint: Describe your usual activities simply and clearly.
sample: I usually get up around seven.

ja.prompt: 日常のルーティンについての質問に一文で答えてください。
ja.hint: 普段の活動を簡潔に説明しましょう。
ja.sample: 私は普段7時ごろ起きます。

local.prompt: Answer questions about your daily routine in one sentence.
local.hint: Describe your usual activities simply and clearly.
local.sample: I usually get up around seven.

zh.prompt: 用一句話回答關於你的日常生活的問題。
zh.hint: 簡單清楚地描述你的日常活動。

en.prompt: Answer questions about your daily routine in one sentence.
en.hint: Describe your usual activities simply and clearly.
en.sample: I usually get up around seven.

title: Preferences and Opinions
prompt: Answer questions about your preferences and opinions with one sentence.
hint: Express likes, dislikes, and opinions clearly.

ja.prompt: あなたの好みや意見についての質問に一文で答えてください。
ja.hint: 好き嫌いや意見をはっきりと表現しましょう。
ja.sample: 私は買い物が好きです。

local.prompt: Answer questions about your preferences and opinions with one sentence.
local.hint: Express likes, dislikes, and opinions clearly.

zh.prompt: 用一句話回答關於你的喜好和意見的問題。
zh.hint: 清楚表達喜歡、不喜歡和意見。

en.prompt: Answer questions about your preferences and opinions with one sentence.
en.hint: Express likes, dislikes, and opinions clearly.

title: Past Experiences
prompt: Answer questions about your past experiences with one sentence.
hint: Use past tense to describe what you have done or experienced.
sample: I ate dinner with my aunt.

ja.prompt: 過去の経験についての質問に一文で答えてください。
ja.hint: 過去形を使って、したことや経験したことを説明しましょう。
ja.sample: 私は昨晩おばと夕食を食べました。

local.prompt: Answer questions about your past experiences with one sentence.
local.hint: Use past tense to describe what you have done or experienced.
local.sample: I ate dinner with my aunt.

zh.prompt: 用一句話回答關於你過去經驗的問題。
zh.hint: 使用過去式描述你做過或經歷過的事。
zh.sample: 我和阿姨一起吃了晚餐。

en.prompt: Answer questions about your past experiences with one sentence.
en.hint: Use past tense to describe what you have done or experienced.
en.sample: I ate dinner with my aunt.

local.prompt: Answer questions about your abilities and skills with one sentence.
local.hint: Describe what you can or cannot do clearly.

en.prompt: Answer questions about your abilities and skills with one sentence.
